# Marisol Quay

## Overview

Keeper of the fourth lock, and the only person still holding that post between
[[Riverfold]] and [[Tallow Quay]].

## Background

Third generation on the locks. She learned the sluice gearing before she learned to
read, which she mentions more often than is strictly necessary.

## At the Locks (Session 2)

Waited three days for [[The Lamplighters]] to send somebody and got the crew instead.
Travelled with them as far as [[Tallow Quay]] and turned back without explaining why.

## Current Status

Back at [[Nine Locks]]. Writing to the Lamplighters weekly and receiving nothing.

## Connections

- [[The Lamplighters]]
- [[Nine Locks]]
- [[Errand - Find the Ledger Keeper]]
- [[Nine Locks#The Jammed Gate (Session 2)]]

## Notes

Knows the river better than the charts do. Will not say what is above the ninth lock.
